product.name: Monoprice Extension Cord - NEMA 5-15P to NEMA 5-15R 16AWG 13A/1625W 3-Prong Black 20ft
product.description: Extend the reach of your AC powered device using this AC power extension cord to power equipment from a distant power outlet. This cable features a standard, grounded NEMA® 5‑15P plug on one end and a NEMA 5‑15R receptacle on the other. Simply plug your device into the receptacle, then plug the other end of the cord into an AC power outlet. These cables are designed to carry up to a 13 amp/1625 watt, 125 volt load.Features: Recommended for powering computers, monitors, and other essential peripheralsIdeal replacement for worn out or missing extension cordsConnect devices, such as computers, servers, and monitors to a PDU Plug TypeNEMA® 5‑15PReceptacle TypeNEMA 5‑15RJacket MaterialSJT# of Conductors3Wire Gauge16 AWGMaximum Current13 ampsCertificationsUL®, cUL, RoHSMonoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
